messages.content:
Write a tech news digest of about 100 words based on these headlines.
Output the digest text only.

Headlines:
- Open-source agent frameworks hit production milestone as adoption triples
- Model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups
- Tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models
- Multi-agent swarms move from demos to regulated enterprise workflows
- Observability standards emerge for tracing agent decisions end to end

message.content: The AI agent landscape is rapidly maturing, transitioning from experimental phases into robust, real-world production environments. Open-source agent frameworks have hit a significant milestone as adoption triples, driven by the quiet replacement of hand-coded orchestration with model-driven agents in startups. Concurrently, tool-calling reliability has become the new benchmark for frontier models, ensuring more accurate and autonomous execution. Meanwhile, multi-agent swarms are advancing rapidly, moving from simple demonstrations to regulated enterprise workflows. To support this complex deployment, observability standards are emerging, enabling end-to-end tracing of agent decisions and fostering essential trust in autonomous systems.
